summary_md:
# Chans till kursdubbling

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-07-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is DI's Kort och lång podcast, recorded on a Friday in the busiest week of the Q2 2026 reporting season. The hosts found the reports broadly strong, with organic growth picking up and currency headwinds fading, and they grew more positive on the economy even though the index slipped on AI-bubble jitters and a flare-up in the Iran conflict. Main topics were strong reports from Volvo, Saab, ABB, Atlas Copco, Assa Abloy, Mips and Inwido, overreactions in Lagercrantz and Addnode (where a share-price doubling is possible if management's explanation holds), disappointments at Axfood and in the mining-equipment makers, and AI investment now reaching Swedish small caps.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 LAGR-B — Lagercrantz | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Fell 15%, a record drop, on a margin miss the host sees as temporary; strong organic growth and orders 10% above invoicing.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Organic growth was 6%, above expectations, and orders ran 10% above invoicing, pointing to continued growth. The margin miss (17.1% vs 17.5%) is blamed on seasonal acquired units and Hormuz-driven cost inflation that has not yet been passed on to customers. If pricing catches up, the case is unchanged and the stock is simply 15% cheaper. Valuation is ~24x EBITA, which explains the sharp reaction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cost inflation is not passed on to customers in coming quarters
- if margin weakness persists beyond seasonal/acquisition effects
- if organic growth slows

> *"15, det känns för kraftigt, så där känner jag mig ändå lite köpsugen"*

---

### 🟢 KARNEL-B — Karnell | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Up 20% on 17% organic growth; host has it as a 'stock of the week' pick; low debt leaves room for more acquisitions.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Strong organic growth (17%) for a serial acquirer, and low debt allows further acquisitions and high growth. The host has been tempted to buy and holds it as a 'stock of the week' pick. The stock is volatile, but so far mostly to the upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth fades
- if leverage rises sharply from acquisitions
- if volatility turns to the downside

> *"Ett annat bolag där jag i alla fall har varit köpsugen är Carnell som jag också har en veckans aktie på"*

---

### 🟢 MIPS — Mips | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

42% organic growth, the legal settlement removes an overhang, and the host's 'stock of the week' pick; case better despite a 28% rise.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Organic growth was 42%, well above expectations, with growth in all segments including bicycle helmets. The costly legal process (>90m SEK) is settled and costs are now foreseeable. The Koroyd acquisition adds growth, and valuation has come down a lot. Host says the case is better even after the 28% rise. Seasonality in helmets is a caveat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth decelerates sharply
- if new legal costs emerge
- if seasonal Q2 strength does not persist

> *"jag tycker ändå att caset känns bättre nu, trots att aktien 28 % dyrare"*

---

### 🟢 INWI — Inwido | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host's best report of the week; low, depressed valuation; early signs the building and renovation cycle is turning.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. The window maker has suffered from high interest rates hitting construction and renovation. The report showed a comeback and early signs of an economic turn. Valuation is low and depressed; the host explicitly bets on Inwido for the long term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates rise again and building activity stalls
- if the economic recovery fails to materialise

> *"Vi satsar långsiktigt på Inwido."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Fell ~17% to ~8x EBITA; host is a 'very cautious optimist' and says the price could double if management's explanation holds.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Negative organic growth in Design Management is blamed by management on Autodesk pricing moving customers from 3-year to 1-year subscriptions, which cuts upfront commissions. The market prices in 'AI death'. At ~8x EBITA vs ~15-16x if management is right, the price could double. Major AI disruption risk to Autodesk and poor company communication.

#### Sell Triggers

- if customer renewal rates fall
- if AI tools displace Autodesk usage
- if management fails to provide better disclosure such as renewal rates

> *"Så jag är en väldigt, väldigt försiktig optimist i det här caset."*

---

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Good report and first positive report reaction after six declines; momentum and upgrades to forecasts are possible; an indirect AI play with high entry barriers.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Compressors are doing well and the vacuum business benefits from semiconductor and data-centre demand. Signs the economy is improving could trigger upgrades to analyst forecasts and build momentum. The host prefers it to AI labs because of higher entry barriers. Valuation is still high.

#### Sell Triggers

- if economic recovery signals fade
- if semiconductor/vacuum demand weakens
- if the high valuation is not supported by upgrades

> *"jag är hellre lång Atlas Copco än att vara aktieägare i Antropic eller OpenAI"*

---

### 🟢 MTG-B — MTG | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host thinks it is valued fairly low after its transformation, could win from AI in gaming, and could spin off PlaySimple.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Gaming companies that use AI to cut monotonous work and free up creative resources could become big winners. MTG has transformed itself, is valued low, and has other triggers such as a possible PlaySimple spin-off.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI efficiency gains fail to materialise
- if the PlaySimple spin-off is shelved and the valuation stays depressed

> *"Jag tycker MTG värderas rätt lågt och de har verkligen gjort en transformation"*

---

### 🟠 ENGCON-B — Engcon | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host speculates it could be a small-cap winner from data-centre construction; organic growth is resuming and orders are strong.

#### Reasoning

Host speculation. The report was okay, with organic growth coming back and fairly strong orders. Its tiltrotators for excavators could benefit if the building cycle is driven by data-centre construction. It has disappointed investors many times before, and hosts called the idea a bit of a wild guess.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stalls again
- if the construction recovery does not materialise

> *"om inte de skulle kunna bli en liten datacenterutbyggnadsvinnare"*

---

### ⛔ AXFO — Axfood | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Host's 'turkey': fell ~15%, losing market share (2.1% vs a market up 3.7%) with Willys weak; poor 5-year return; 'needs to turn this trend around'.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Supposed to be the exchange's safest stock, but it keeps disappointing and communicating poorly with the market. Retail growth trails the market, and the Willys discount chain has lost its shine. Total return is only 14% over 5 years. The current environment should favour it, which makes the underperformance worse.

> *"Det är för dåligt helt enkelt. Det är inte tillräckligt bra."*

---

### ⛔ 000660 — SK Hynix | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

The US dual listing traded at a 51% premium to the Korean shares; host is not tempted to buy.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. A premium of this size looks irrational, and the stock was falling. The host explicitly says he is not tempted to buy.

> *"Det där är en duktig premie. Jag blir inte köpsugen."*

---
